ITEM 1 | Long strip with wavy, curled edges, golden-orange to reddish-brown with darker crisp browned edges and translucent fatty streaks, slightly glossy and oily sheen, lying across the upper-left of a white paper plate, about 12 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, roughly 0.3 cm thick | 18
ITEM 2 | Two overlapping strips with wavy, curled edges, reddish-brown to golden with crisp browned rims and pale fat streaks, glossy oily sheen, lying in the center-right of a white paper plate, each about 10 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, roughly 0.3 cm thick | 22
ITEM 3 | Short curled strip with crisp, darker browned edges and pale translucent fat, slightly glossy, positioned at the right side of the plate near the other strips, about 7 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, roughly 0.3 cm thick | 8
ITEM 4 | Small pinkish-red specks and smears scattered across the white plate surface, moist and slightly glossy, possibly residual grease, very thin layer | 2
